en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of an outdoor garden café or beer garden with empty tables and chairs arranged under leafless trees. The tables are covered with tablecloths, some with vases of flowers. In the background, there are historical buildings with stone foundations and arched windows, partially covered in ivy. A stone staircase leads up to a terrace, and the architecture suggests a Central European setting.
